hooks.command: branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ "$branch" = "main" ] || [ "$branch" = "master" ]; then echo "[chimera] Refusing to Edit/Write on '$branch' — create a feature branch first (git checkout -b feat/..., or use superpowers:using-git-worktrees)." >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
